model_output:
```sql
WITH pois_in_chicago AS (
  SELECT id, geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
    AND addr_city ILIKE 'Chicago'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'IL'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      1,
      p.geometry::geometry,
      TRUE
    )).val AS elevation
  FROM pois_in_chicago p
  JOIN public.dem_us r
    ON ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, p.geometry::geometry)
),
elevations_above_500 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM clipped_dem
  WHERE elevation > 500
)
SELECT count FROM elevations_above_500;
```
